        spy_previous_close = self.spy_closes[1]

        spy_sma_yesterday = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100

            spy_previous_close <= spy_sma_yesterday
            and spy_close > spy_sma_today
        )

            spy_previous_close >= spy_sma_yesterday

            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            quantity = int(
                (self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 40) /
                (100 * data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
            )

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and aapl_red_three_days:
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity
